title: Canonical derived open restriction and direct-image composition

proof.text: Use the specified upperStarComp and upperStarLowerStarAdjunction of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Allow a named composite by preceding the pullback compositor with equality transport. The source upperStarComp_hom_app_comp_upperStarComp_hom_app proves associativity for these flexible compositors. Lift it through exact derivation using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_trans, the two whiskering laws, and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_assoc. These calculations are proved private helpers in the item module.

Define exactSquare as the inverse source pullback compositor followed by the target compositor. Apply the exact associativity equation to the triples (i,f,g), (f′,j,g), and (f′,g′,a), with common composite i(fg). Cancel the intermediate isomorphisms to obtain the vertical square-pasting equation. Preservation of composition, inversion and equality transport identifies exactSquare with the inverse of the specified derivedOpenCoherencePullbackSquare of [def-sfb-derived-direct-image-open-coherence-data]. Invert the component equation by composing with the appropriate invertible source and target maps; this gives equality of the conjugate-whiskered TwoSquares.

Identify the conjugate of the inverse exact-derived compositor with directImageComposition of [def-sfb-derived-direct-image-open-coherence-data]. Apply the existing proved source theorem Adjunction.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_hom_eq_conjugateEquiv (CompConjugate.lean) to the specified upperStar/lowerStar adjunctions and upperStarComp. Its ordinary conjugate hypothesis is exactly conjugateIsoEquiv_upperStarComp. Equality of isomorphism homs and then inverses gives the needed normalization; rightDerivedFunctorCompIso' unfolds to the inverse of directImageComposition. No additional resolution comparison is postulated.

Apply mateEquiv to the equality of TwoSquares using the direct derived adjunction for fg and the composite derived adjunction for g′ then f′. The conjugate-whiskering identities and mateEquiv_hcomp of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] turn its two sides into the two routes of the claimed mixed direct-image/restriction diagram. Replace the two conjugates by directImageComposition using the preceding normalization, and identify the square mates with the actual derivedDirectImageOpenRestriction. Evaluation at K removes identity associator components and proves DirectImageRestrictionComposition. Only commutativity of the given pullback squares is used.
